description:
Watch curated regulatory effective dates and deadlines in a bounded window.

    `since_days` controls both recently effective dates behind today and
    effective/deadline dates ahead of today. This is a source-linked watch
    over the curated Viridis dataset, not a live external regulatory feed.

jurisdiction.description: Where the company operates, for example california, us, eu or uk.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

since_days.description: Optional. Window in days, before and after today. Default 90.
since_days.title: Since Days

topics.description: Optional. Topics to keep, for example ["ghg", "scope 3"].
topics.title: Topics

name: monitor_changes
title: Monitor changes
